source: function helper(fn:(n:number)=>number, later=(0)):number{return fn(3)+later;}const result=helper(function(n){return n+1;});export const observed=result;
function helper(values: [(n:number)=>number]):number{return values[0](3);}const result=helper([n=>n+1]);export const observed=result;

/** @param {(n:number)=>number} fn */
function helper(fn){return fn(3);}const result=helper(n=>n+1);export const observed=result;
